q1\n    return q1 - k * iqr, q3 + k * iqr\n\n\ndef answer() -> list[int]:\n    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n\n    ordered_outliers = []\n    seen = set()\n\n    def add(indices):\n        for i in indices:\n            i = int(i)\n            if i not in seen:\n                seen.add(i)\n                ordered_outliers.append(i)\n\n    # --- Step 1: technical noise (impossible values) in numeric columns ---\n    noise_age = df.index[(df[\"age\"] > AGE_MAX) | (df[\"age\"] < 0)]\n    noise_bmi = df.index[(df[\"bmi\"] < BMI_MIN) | (df[\"bmi\"] > BMI_MAX)]\n    noise_glucose = df.index[\n        (df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] < GLUCOSE_MIN) | (df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] > GLUCOSE_MAX)\n    ]\n    noise_idx = set(noise_age) | set(noise_bmi) | set(noise_glucose)\n    add(sorted(noise_idx))\n\n    clean = df.drop(index=noise_idx).copy()\n\n    # --- Step 2: standard 3*IQR outlier detection on numeric columns ---\n    standard_outliers = set()\n\n    for col in [\"age\", \"bmi\"]:\n        lower, upper = iqr_bounds(clean[col])\n        out_idx = clean.index[(clean[col] < lower) | (clean[col] > upper)]\n        standard_outliers |= set(out_idx)\n\n    # avg_glucose_level requires the stroke-association check before rejecting\n    lower, upper = iqr_bounds(clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n    glucose_candidates = clean.index[\n        (clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"] < lower) | (clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"] > upper)\n    ]\n\n    if len(glucose_candidates) > 0:\n        candidate_set = clean.loc[glucose_candidates]\n        n = len(candidate_set)\n        # stroke rate among \"other\" candidate observations, per candidate\n        total_stroke = candidate_set[\"stroke\"].sum()\n\n        log_col = np.log2(clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n        log_lower, log_upper = iqr_bounds(log_col)\n\n        for idx in glucose_candidates:\n            own_stroke = clean.loc[idx, \"stroke\"]\n            others_stroke_rate = (total_stroke -
